name: Generic SMTP / IMAP Email Provider
author: OpenOptOut
description: A server-agnostic email provider: sends via SMTP and reads confirmations via IMAP against ANY server the operator configures (host, port, TLS). Use it for self-hosted / on-premises mail, or any provider without a dedicated plugin. No server is hardcoded — the SMTP/IMAP host and port come from the stored account settings. Trusted email-provider class; host inspects for hidden recipients and enforces the recipient at send time.
outbound_domains_note: The mail server is operator-configured and not known at authoring time. '*' signals 'operator-defined host'; the host binds the actual allowed destination to the configured smtp_host/imap_host at enable time (see host-side email dispatch).
